BiblicalUsage: Jearim is the name of the mountain on the border of Judah, where the boundary passed from Baalah westward to Mount Seir. The verse calls it Mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, and the border went down from there to Beth-shemesh.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God marks His borders by mountains, and Mount Jearim still stands where the line was drawn.
